DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The findings of a continuous machinery murmur (Patent Ductus Arteriosus), congenital cataracts, and bilateral sensorineural hearing loss, combined with a positive Rubella IgM, are the classic triad known as "German Measles Triad" indicative of in utero rubella infection.
